_about: Where the tracker reads Measure RTM for each county besides Alameda. Fill in the Clarity addresses on election night: open the county's results link and copy the part up to the election number, e.g. https://results.enr.clarityelections.com/CA/Contra_Costa/126374 The MTC entry is the district's own combined total and takes precedence once it has numbers.

MTC.note: The district's combined five-county total, posted from about 9 p.m. Nov. 3. Used when it shows Yes/No totals; otherwise the counties below are added up. Set url to null to always use the counties.

Contra Costa.note: Set the Nov. 3 Clarity address from contracostavote.gov/november-3-2026-election-results

Santa Clara.note: Set the Nov. 3 Clarity address from the 'Official Election Results' link on vote.santaclaracounty.gov
